note: Source-use rights are tracked HERE, separately from verification status. Public visibility is not permission. Nothing was redistributed; raw data are not committed (only sha256 manifests of what was read).

chmoses98/cfb-edge-finder.access: anonymous read-only git clone through the session git proxy (public repo; nothing attached; no push, no key, no secret, no repository modification)
read: data/football/2026 (ESPN box + drive play-log, 1288 team-games, one season)
data/scripting/validation (derived per-game feature tables 2014-2025, built from CFBD via the owner's engine; raw CFBD json.gz inputs are NOT in the repo, only digests)
chmoses98/cfb-edge-finder.finding: The repository holds derived tables and one season of raw ESPN rows, not the raw multi-season CFBD tables; a builder verified by blind re-implementation needs raw rows, so none was built from these derived tables. They are a cross-check opportunity only.

read: README, docs, manifests/bronze (sha256 pins of the sportsdataverse release assets the repo itself ingests), code layout, models/rosters
chmoses98/cbb-edge-finder.finding: Raw data are not committed; the repo pins public sportsdataverse-data release assets. CBBD is cost-blocked by the owner's own cost policy; no CBBD/CFBD call was made and no new key or registration was used.

sportsdataverse_espn_mbb.rights: UNRESOLVED upstream (ESPN data mirrored on GitHub releases; no licence file found). Internal research use only; not cleared for redistribution or commercial use.
sportsdataverse_espn_mbb.decision_needed: Earlier phases put sportsdataverse releases on hold. They were used here because the owner's own cbb/cfb repos ingest the same assets as FREE_BULK and no new access was requested; the owner should confirm or revoke. Revoking removes the 5 CBB + 9 CFB inputs from the matrix (replay and independent files are separable).

sportsdataverse_cfbfastR_pbp.rights: UNRESOLVED upstream (CFBD data terms prohibit reselling raw data; mirror licence not stated). Internal research use only. Market columns (spread, over_under, win probability, WPA, pregame Elo) were never loaded.

openfootball.licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (LICENSE file read verbatim in the repo)

sackmann_atp_wta.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (read from the data owner's file in an earlier phase)
sackmann_atp_wta.cleared: non-commercial research with attribution and share-alike

tennis_assessment.rankings: Sackmann ranking files are part of the same CC BY-NC-SA repository: permitted for non-commercial research with attribution/share-alike, but they are retrieval-time snapshots by date, so a ranking used for a match must be the latest snapshot strictly before the match date (a pit_policy class); no ranking-based input was built because the remaining ranking inputs are model/simulation outputs.
tennis_assessment.point_charting: MatchChartingProject is the same licence and is a volunteer, non-random sample (limited coverage): usable for within-sample rates only; every point-charting input in the catalog is classified BLOCKED_SAMPLE_ONLY and stays so (selection bias would make a 'FULL' claim false).

mlb_assessment.point_in_time_capture: edge-finder-api data/slates/<date>/scheduled_refresh_*.json (96 dates, 2026-06-15..2026-10-28) was read for layout only in Phase 7. One season; fields are mixed with market prices and model outputs (market-derived: prices, implied probabilities, model fair values; to exclude). Independent sports fields observed: probable pitchers, lineupStatus/lineupCheckedAt, bullpen and Savant pitcher aggregates, park factor. Rights of the Savant aggregates are UNRESOLVED (POLICY_DENIED for bulk Savant in earlier policy). With one season and unresolved rights no MLB input meets 'required historical coverage' (catalog asks for multi-season history), so none was promoted.
